tool.name: wikEd Lite
tool.description: Format the selection, or the whole source when nothing is selected
dialog.title: Format wikitext
dialog.intro: Choose the optional formatting to apply. Safe basic fixes always run.
dialog.subsequentParameterGroup: Subsequent parameters on the same line
dialog.characterWidthFiveToThree: Pad using a 5:3 Chinese-to-English character-width ratio
dialog.normalizeConversion: Format semicolons in Chinese conversion rules
dialog.normalizeConversionDescription: Formats top-level semicolons in recognized {{NoteTA}} and -{...}- rules. No-conversion terms remain unchanged.
dialog.resolveRedirects: Replace wikilink redirects with target page titles
dialog.resolveDescriptionAfter: . Use it only to repair navigation templates or similar links that must point directly to target pages. The many API requests may noticeably slow formatting.
dialog.editorFeaturesDescription: Display switches take effect immediately. Save the settings to restore them next time.
dialog.highlightMissing: Highlight links to nonexistent pages in red
dialog.highlightMissingDescription: Checks links when enabled and after editing stops. API requests run in the background.
dialog.smallReferenceText: Show references and notes in small text
dialog.fullPageReferencePreviews: Use whole-page source for reference previews
dialog.fullPageReferencePreviewsDescript: During section editing, loads the whole-page source in the background.
feedback.noEditor: No MediaWiki source editor was found.
feedback.openFailed: Wikitext formatter could not open. Try again.
feedback.selection: Wikitext formatting was applied to the selection.
feedback.whole: Wikitext formatting was applied to the whole source.
feedback.failed: Wikitext formatting failed. Review the source and try again.
feedback.settingsSaveFailed: Formatter settings could not be saved in this browser.
